recognize_zh: 中倍骨髓抹片中絕大多數是深藍色細胞質的大型原始細胞，常見細胞質泡突與沿細胞邊緣排列的一圈小空泡，並有較小的成熟紅血球母細胞散在，呈現以原紅血球樣原始細胞為主的族群。
features: Predominant population of large blasts with high N:C ratio, round nuclei and fine chromatin
Intensely basophilic cytoplasm with cytoplasmic blebs
Rows of small cytoplasmic vacuoles, often at the cell periphery
Scattered smaller dark-nucleated erythroid precursors and occasional binucleate blasts
Few mature granulocytes; background erythrocytes and some disrupted cells
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear at intermediate magnification shows a markedly increased population of large blasts with high N:C ratio, round nuclei, fine chromatin and deeply basophilic cytoplasm with blebs and conspicuous peripheral vacuolization. Smaller, more mature erythroid precursors are scattered among them, whereas maturing granulocytes are scant. The morphology suggests a predominance of proerythroblast-like blasts; with confirmation of erythroid lineage by E-cadherin, CD71 or glycophorin and quantification of erythroid precursors (at least 80%, with at least 30% proerythroblasts), the findings are consistent with pure erythroid leukemia.

ddx.vs: Megakaryoblasts can look identical with blebby basophilic cytoplasm, so CD61/CD42b versus E-cadherin/CD71 immunophenotyping is required.
Burkitt cells show numerous punched-out vacuoles across the whole cytoplasm with a CD10+/CD19+/sIg+ B-cell phenotype and MYC rearrangement.

ddx.dx: AML with maturation or myelodysplastic neoplasm with excess blasts
ddx.vs: Myeloblasts are less basophilic, may contain granules or Auer rods, and are MPO/CD34 positive, with a non-dominant erythroid component.

ddx.dx: Metastatic small round cell tumor (e.g., neuroblastoma, rhabdomyosarcoma)
ddx.vs: Solid tumor cells form tight cohesive clumps or rosettes and are negative for hematopoietic markers.
